name: model_op_rms_norm
description: SGLang RMSNorm without residual (sglang/srt/layers/layernorm.py RMSNorm). x [..., hidden_size] float16/bfloat16/float32, weight [hidden_size] same dtype, eps float. Normalizes over the last dimension in float32 (variance = mean(x^2), x * rsqrt(variance + eps)), scales by weight, and casts back to the input dtype. Returns a new tensor; the input is not modified.
